classification: sampled CPU pilot; not formal evidence

learning.risk: squared Euclidean norm of half-tail PR average

probe.fingerprint: exact equality of sampled stationary state paths; SHA-256 is the implementation-equivalent message
probe.decision: exact T-052 plug-in action from observed match count

comparators.true_rho_oracle: T-050 catalogue minimizer, using the full no-probe total budget
comparators.sample_path_oracle: descriptive only; minimum fixed-q endpoint on the same seed

analysis.cell_endpoint: arithmetic mean PR squared error over the 8 frozen seeds
analysis.aggregate: geometric mean of cell controller/strong-fixed mean-error ratios
analysis.active_cell: true-rho oracle q differs from the overhead-specific strong fixed q
analysis.inactive_cell: true-rho oracle q equals the overhead-specific strong fixed q
analysis.common_random_numbers: one common plus 16 private exact Gymnasium trajectory banks shared by controller and all fixed-q comparators

mandatory_gates.P1: all sampling-table transition, innovation-mean, and second-moment residuals pass their frozen tolerances
mandatory_gates.P2: all endpoints are finite and obey separate message/environment/delay budgets
mandatory_gates.P4: controller/strong-fixed geometric ratio <= 0.97 on every task
mandatory_gates.P5: controller/strong-fixed geometric ratio <= 0.97 at each registered delay
mandatory_gates.P6: controller improves the cell mean error in at least 0.60 of oracle-active cells
mandatory_gates.P9: median selected q is nonincreasing on the registered rho grid for each overhead
mandatory_gates.P11: all 8 seeds are new, all 84 cells and 672 endpoints are present, and sampled/fixed marginal provenance is unchanged
